figurative_meaning_en: A bull released in the name of Allah/God
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামের রাস্তায় একটা খোদাই ষাঁড় ঘুরে বেড়াচ্ছে, কেউ তাকে ধরতে সাহস করে না।
সে খোদাই ষাঁড়ের মতো স্বাধীনভাবে জীবন যাপন করে।
example_sentences_in_english: A khudai shand roams freely on the village road, no one dares to catch it.
He lives freely like a khudai shand.
history: In Bengali Muslim culture, this refers to a tradition where a bull is dedicated to God (Allah or Khoda) as a vow (nazr) and set free to roam without harm, symbolizing divine protection.
note: The idiom highlights religious practices in rural Bengal, emphasizing untouchability due to divine dedication.
